issues.title: Ingest Clay County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $10,765,483 across 28 funds. The largest: County General ($4,496,289), Roads ($3,693,610), Addt'l Motor Fuel Tax ($674,166). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.
